text:
riley (pm): Heads-up: a prospect asked for regionally priced tiers — EU customers want a slightly higher-priced package that guarantees EU-only model variants + regional priority routing. Thinking pilot: "Regional Plus" add-on. Need quick product/contract feasibility check.

cesar (sales): Prospect is a regulated marketplace; they'd pay for EU-only routing. They also asked for a soft SLA during business hours. They'll push for per-route guarantees.

riley (pm): Proposed product shape: base hosted API (global) + Regional Plus add-on ($/mo) which: 1) marks tenant as region-bound, 2) routes eligible requests to regional model pool, 3) includes small priority buffer for business hours. Commit reserved capacity optional.

talia (eng): Feasibility: regional routing + tenant tag is straightforward. Hard part is maintaining identical model variants and sync across regions; quantization/weights must be consistent. We can do regional pools in 2 sprints for pilot (US/EU). Priority buffer is a prioritized queue — ops work.

ben (ops): Ops note: regional pools need separate capacity and monitoring. For pilot we can provision small EU pool (eu-west-1) on trial. Committed capacity requires separate contracts. Also need accepted outage handling for cross-region failover.

omar (finance): Pricing: EU+ priority should have a premium to cover higher infra + compliance costs. Rough sketch: add-on $299/mo + optional reserve pack pricing. Need margin sim. Also ask: tax/VAT handling for regional billing.

irene (legal): Contract concerns: explicit data residency clause, failover behavior, and SLA carveouts. Draft obligation: "Redwood will, subject to capacity, route eligible inference requests from Customer to regional pools. In the event of regional capacity constraints or safety events, Redwood may route to alternate pools and will notify Customer." Need to define "eligible" and notification timelines.

jo (devex): SDK change: tenant config flag + header override. Docs should include region constraints and sample error codes for cross-region failover. Also need an eval harness to compare outputs across regions for parity checks.

cesar (sales): Pilot asks: 1) 30-day trial of Regional Plus, 2) visibility into usage per region, 3) incidental cross-region failover logs for audits. Customers will want audit trails.

omar (finance): Exporting per-region usage to billing is doable. We'll need event-level logs for VAT reconciliation.

talia (eng): Parity testing: we'll run a small suite of eval prompts across regions and check for divergence. If divergence > threshold, we shouldn't promise parity. That affects legal language.

irene (legal): Agreed. Also add a clause permitting temporary cross-region routing for safety/compliance with notice. We'll draft redlines.

ben (ops): ETA: can stand up EU pool in 10 business days for pilot. Need expected QPS from sales. Also need a runbook for failover and notification.

riley (pm): Launch checklist draft: 1) tenant regional tag + routing in staging, 2) EU pool provisioned, 3) billing exports per region, 4) contract addendum + redlines, 5) devex quickstart + eval harness, 6) 1 pilot customer (EU) for 30 days.

cesar (sales): I'll confirm pilot customer and QPS by EOD Thu.

omar (finance): I'll model pricing scenarios and VAT handling by Tue.

irene (legal): Posting redlines tomorrow. Need to define notification SLAs.

talia (eng): We'll prepare parity eval results before pilot kickoff.

jo (devex): I'll build quickstart and include region parity checklist.

ben (ops): Will share runbook draft in kickoff.

riley (pm): If no vetoes, locking pilot scope: US/EU, tenant-level Regional Plus add-on, 30-day trial for pilot, per-region usage exports. Kickoff Wed 9am PT. Speak up now with objections.

cesar (sales): No veto. proceeding to recruit customer.

omar (finance): No veto.

irene (legal): Will submit redlines.

riley (pm): Thanks — MRD snapshot + owner list coming shortly.
